summary: The comment opposes allowing parents to opt-out of screen-based instruction, emphasizing the importance of parental involvement in their children's education.

claims.requested_action: Allow parents to opt-out of screen-based instruction
claims.argument: Parents should have full access to their children's educational content
claims.evidence_quote: Parents must be allowed to be informed, to give consent and to have full access to all that their child may see, hear, or be in the presence of.
